name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free desktop app that clones voices, turns text into natural speech, dubs videos into other languages, and transcribes audio — all running on your own computer instead of a paid cloud subscription.
buyer: An indie audiobook producer or YouTube channel localizer who currently pays monthly for ElevenLabs and wants unlimited generation without per-character fees.
business_use_cases: An audiobook studio clones a narrator's voice once, then generates chapters overnight on local hardware instead of paying per-character cloud fees.
A YouTube educator dubs their back-catalog of videos into 10 languages to unlock non-English ad revenue without hiring voice actors.
A call-center trainer uses the dictation and transcription tools to turn recorded coaching calls into searchable text libraries.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a hosted, managed version with a simple UI for creators who don't want to install anything, priced per seat.
Offer a done-for-you dubbing service built on top of it: upload a video, get back 5 dubbed language versions.
Bundle it into a paid audiobook-production course that teaches self-published authors to self-narrate at scale.

steal_this: This weekend, wrap VoiceStudio's dubbing pipeline in a simple web form: creators upload a clip, pick target languages, and get dubbed MP4s back by email.
